reviewer_statement: Provisional author-reviewed source-scientific native R Python 1.2 serialization for accepted fixed sparse MFPCA and other documented native types. Python 1.2 recognizes the serialized science, but R neither provides arbitrary dataclass support nor impersonates Python environment classes. New direct oracle CI not yet proven passing.
native_language_semantic_policy: Native R writer is JSON+NPZ and Python 1.2 loader-interoperable in declared domain, but not a Python interpreter, class identity, or environment capture. Unknown source dataclasses, optional selectors and Python overwrite semantics remain unavailable. This is a bounded developmental ledger record, not a certified complete source API.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python 1.2 src/eyetrajectoriespy/portable_results.py::export_portable_result; Native Python 1.2 scientific JSON+NPZ portable writer extended from common/irregular trajectory and dense/compositional FPCA to 29-field strict sparse planar joint covariance/PACE, and to strict fixed-bandwidth paired sparse MFPCA W2 scientific workflow.

Accepted native source-scientific result domain now includes full 29-field paired sparse MFPCA scientific records and 12-field W2 fixed-bandwidth workflows with one measured fit step and no optional selector, score uncertainty or observation diagnostics. Also retains prior supported trajectory/dense/compositional FPCA result families. Explicitly refuses non-source native marginal models, malformed altered dimensions, arbitrary dataclasses, Python environment spoofing and destructive overwrite.

New frozen Python 1.2 direct load_portable_result tests decode NumPy C-order numeric arrays, 29 ordered SparseMFPCAResult dataclass scientific fields, covariance blocks, eigenpairs, scores, curve identifiers and pandas metadata; R standalone reader checks exact NPZ shapes, checksums, schema, units and scientific values. Historical dense/irregular direct interoperability tests continue. The tests are committed but not yet witnessed green.

Native bounded R writer requires exact strict scientific source class, rejects invalid arrays, no non-finite grid/spectrum, explicit unsupported optional mode, nonempty existing directory, include_environment=TRUE and overwrite=TRUE. Python dataclass arbitrary type identity and original Python error exceptions cannot be matched natively.

Python 1.2 portable manifest v1 with arrays.npz, manifest.json, SHA256 arrays checksum, source type strings eyetrajectoriespy.types.SparseMFPCAResult or eyetrajectoriespy.workflows._sparse_mfpca.SparseMFPCAWorkflowResult, source-native ndarray/dataframe/tuple/mapping/dataclass markers, actual scientific measurements and explicit R-native version and environment NULL; Python reader produces scientific payload with nonportable_fields empty.

Portable state reproduces real native R direct paired sparse covariance/PACE scientific estimates and fit-only source workflow record; no invented covariance model, no raw interpolation, no information silently dropped for accepted input type.

independent_review_status: Scoped developer review only; exact-head native and Python 1.2 CI queued/not verified; independent scientific certification remains zero.
language_specific_limits: Arbitrary Python dataclass objects and Python environment capture are outside native R supported input domain.
R runtime result classes and Python dataclass objects are distinct. Portable snapshots intentionally do not reconstruct opaque backend fits.
Python and R report strings, csv bytes, path objects and exception class identity need not be identical; source reader compatibility and scientific values are primary bounded target.
Python workflow export supports further optional report and selector families not yet included. This author review is provisional and not independent certification.
